基本远程控制免费。中国大陆 iOS App Store：VIP ¥24/月、SV: Basic remote control is free. Mainland China iOS App Store: VIP ¥24/month and SVIP ¥88/month, both auto-renewing. Website and other regional prices and membership benefits have not been verified.
官网及官方应用介绍声明端到端加密；不能推导为零数据收集。: The official website and app description claim end-to-end encryption; this does not imply zero data collection.
免费远控宣传不能替代明确商业授权: Free remote-control marketing does not establish an explicit commercial-use license.
各平台版本不同，仅核实官方文档，未安装客户端。: Versions differ by platform. This entry is based on official documentation; the client has not been tested.
可免费开始使用，无需绑卡。官方定价表列明 Starter 的调试规则限 1 条，: Free to start with no credit card required. The official pricing table lists a one-rule limit for Starter and excludes Breakpoint and Map Local. Features may vary by platform.
浏览器下载面板支持部分流媒体，但不支持带有复制保护的流，也不保证支持所有 M3U: The browser download panel supports some streams but does not support copy-protected streams or guarantee support for every M3U8 link.
在已集成的浏览器中播放受支持的视频时，可用视频下载面板；仅添加网页地址不会下载视: The video download panel is available when playing supported videos in an integrated browser. Adding a webpage address alone does not download the video.
官方列出 .raw 和 .rw2 格式，生成预览时可使用文件内嵌的预览图（如有）: Official docs list .raw and .rw2 formats. Preview generation can use an embedded preview if one is available. That is different from professional RAW development.
可创建结构化训练课表，也可下载在 MyWhoosh 里记录的历史骑行 FIT 文: You can create structured workouts and download FIT files of rides recorded in MyWhoosh. Support for importing third-party activity history has not been verified.
开源网站与产品分析工具，可按流量、来源和行为事件分析，并支持自建。: Open-source web and product analytics for traffic, referrers, and behavior events, with self-hosting available.
自建软件免费，服务器和 PostgreSQL 自备；官方云版 Hobby 每月: Self-hosted software is free; provide hosting and PostgreSQL. Umami Cloud Hobby is $0/month and Pro is $20/month.
1 个网站，每月 10 万事件，数据保留 6 个月。: 1 website, 100,000 events per month, and six months of data retention.
按月价格，含每月 100 万事件；额外事件每次 0.00003 美元。: Monthly price, including 1 million events per month; additional events cost $0.00003 each.
仅软件免费，需自行承担服务器、数据库和运维成本。: The software is free; you pay for hosting, database, and operations.
Hobby 最多 1 个网站，每月 10 万事件，保留 6 个月。页面访问、自定: Hobby covers one website and 100,000 events per month with six months of retention. Page hits, custom events and some properties count toward usage; the cap is not a visitor count. Pricing does not list additional events for Hobby. Over-limit handling and card requirements were not verified.
统计页面浏览、设备与流量来源。: Tracks page views, devices, and traffic sources.
使用 UTM 参数区分推广链接。: Uses UTM parameters to distinguish campaign links.
可定义点击和下载等事件；需在站点添加事件采集。: Define actions such as clicks and downloads by adding event instrumentation.
可用页面浏览或已埋点的事件构建漏斗。: Build funnels from page views or tracked events.
可在统计脚本中手动启用 Core Web Vitals 采集。: Core Web Vitals collection can be enabled in the tracking script.
可自行部署，需要 PostgreSQL。: Self-hosting is available and requires PostgreSQL.
Cloudflare 提供的免费网站统计，覆盖页面浏览、流量来源与真实访客性能。: Cloudflare’s free website analytics for page views, traffic sources, and real-user performance.
Web Analytics 免费，不要求切换 DNS 或启用 Cloudflar: Web Analytics is free and does not require a DNS change or the Cloudflare proxy.
仅指 Web Analytics，不代表 Cloudflare 其他服务免费。: Applies to Web Analytics, not other Cloudflare services.
官方 FAQ 列出每个账户 10 个站点的软限制，可申请调整。未核实报表保留期及: The official FAQ lists a soft limit of 10 websites per account, adjustable on request. Report retention and card requirements were not verified.
通过浏览器脚本统计页面和来源。: Reports page and referrer data from a browser beacon.
不记录 URL 查询参数，因此不提供 UTM 报表。: Query strings are not logged, so UTM reporting is unavailable.
官方 FAQ 明确当前不支持自定义事件。: The official FAQ says custom events are not supported.
Web Analytics 不提供基于页面及自定义事件的产品漏斗。: Web Analytics does not offer product funnels built from pages and custom events.
报告真实用户的核心网页性能指标。: Reports Core Web Vitals from real users.
这是 Cloudflare 托管服务，非可下载的自建软件。: A Cloudflare-hosted service, not downloadable self-hosted software.
